technicalDetails: Native VICE remains the version-specific VSF reader and writer; native .vsf is the day-one canonical ViceSharp snapshot format, never an opt-in or secondary export.

The current bridge exports RAM, written 6510 port values, CPU architectural registers, VIC-II and CIA state, but it resets rather than imports native CPU in-flight state; the plan requires real manifest-mapped pipeline transfer.

Production contracts have closed model selectors, typed immutable state records, exact protobuf/import boundaries, error codes, independent per-DLL 10-second cancellable native acquisition, lock boundaries, session-generation revalidation, rollback and rollback-failure behavior.

The envelope validator follows pinned VICE framing: current 58-byte and legacy 37-byte headers, 22-byte module headers, little-endian inclusive lengths, and exact EOF; it has no invented module-count or file-size compatibility cap. Native VICE parses payloads, and VSF has no general checksum.

Fixture generation is bound to exact ROM hashes. Local evidence verifies the 24-module C64 fixture, pinned VICE commit, MSYS2 paths, selector vocabularies, and current recursive PE dependency closure.

CaptureSnapshot, Avalonia file save/load, quick save/load, and ten named slots use native .vsf by default; generated protobuf ImportLegacySnapshot alone accepts proprietary readers. Unsupported hosts return unavailable without fallback.
